articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 in mid-May 2026, featuring significantly improved chain-of-thought reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a context window exceeding 1 million tokens. The model demonstrates near-expert performance on graduate-level STEM benchmarks and introduces a new "deep research" mode that can autonomously browse, synthesize, and cite sources over multi-step queries.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Breakthrough in Agentic Code Generation
articles.summary: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Ultra 2 with state-of-the-art scores on SWE-Bench and HumanEval, capable of autonomously navigating large codebases, writing integration tests, and submitting pull requests with minimal human guidance. The system uses a novel planning architecture that decomposes complex software engineering tasks into verifiable sub-goals, significantly reducing hallucinated code paths.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoid in BMW Factories
articles.summary: Figure announced that its third-generation humanoid robot, Figure 03, has entered full commercial deployment at two BMW manufacturing plants in South Carolina. The robots handle parts kitting, quality inspection, and bin-picking tasks alongside human workers, leveraging on-board vision-language models for real-time task adaptation without manual reprogramming.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Electric Demonstrates Fully Autonomous Warehouse Navigation
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics released footage and technical details of its electric Atlas robot performing end-to-end autonomous warehouse logistics, including pallet manipulation, obstacle-rich navigation, and dynamic replanning when encountering unexpected layouts. The system relies on a transformer-based world model trained on hundreds of thousands of hours of simulated and real-world warehouse data.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Monitoring Framework as Open Standard
articles.summary: Anthropic open-sourced its Constitutional AI Monitoring (CAIM) framework, a set of tools and protocols for continuously auditing large language model outputs against safety constitutions in production environments. The framework includes real-time drift detection, automated red-teaming pipelines, and standardized reporting formats, and has already been adopted by several enterprise AI providers.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed that its A14 (1.4nm-class) process using gate-all-around nanosheet transistors has entered volume production at its Kaohsiung fab, with initial customers including Apple and NVIDIA. The node delivers approximately 25% performance improvement and 35% power reduction over N2, critical for next-generation AI accelerator and mobile SoC designs.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations at Scale
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum announced a milestone in quantum computing, demonstrating reliable operations on 12 logical qubits with error rates below the fault-tolerance threshold using their hybrid ion-trap architecture. This represents a significant step toward practical quantum advantage for optimization and materials simulation problems, with a roadmap to 100+ logical qubits by 2028.

articles.title: Meta Releases Llama 4 Behemoth as Open-Weight Model with MoE Architecture
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth, a massive mixture-of-experts model with over 2 trillion total parameters and 288 billion active parameters per forward pass, under a permissive open-weight license. Benchmarks place it competitive with closed frontier models on reasoning and multilingual tasks, intensifying the debate around open vs. closed AI development and giving the open-source ecosystem its most capable foundation model to date.
